title: Apartment deep clean
description: Deep clean of a two bedroom apartment: floors, surfaces, bathroom, oven and rubbish removal.

criteria.label: Floor is clear of dust and marks
criteria.howToVerify: Floors across the visible rooms should look clean with no dust, crumbs or visible marks.

criteria.label: Surfaces wiped, no streaks
criteria.howToVerify: Counters, tables and shelves should be free of streaks, dust and spills.

criteria.label: Sink/bathroom spotless
criteria.howToVerify: The sink and bathroom surfaces should have no limescale, hair or soap residue.

criteria.label: Oven interior has no visible grease
criteria.howToVerify: The inside of the oven (door open, racks visible) should show no grease or burnt residue.

criteria.label: Rubbish removed
criteria.howToVerify: Bins are empty and no rubbish bags are left in the rooms.

criteria.label: Liveness code 4821 visible in at least one after photo (written on paper or shown on a phone screen)
criteria.howToVerify: Look for a handwritten or phone-displayed 4 digit code in the after photos and read it.
